    perturber = PerturbationModel()

            with open(RESULT_DIR / "detectgpt_results.json", "w") as f:

            summary_bal.append(metrics["d1d3_bal_acc"])

    print(f"\nResults saved to {RESULT_DIR / 'detectgpt_results.json'}")
